description.text: The fifteenth set of the EX series, released in November 2006 with 101 cards and two theme decks, Power Wave and Shadow Blaze. It is the last set with Delta Species Pokémon and the one most given over to them: set on far-off islands where Delta Species are native, every Pokémon in it but four reprints is a Delta Species, among them Rayquaza ex and Dragonite ex. Its Pokémon Star, Charizard and Mew, are Delta Species too.
